details: AllMouse PASS SNP/indel source; script retains biallelic A/C/G/T; outgroup fixed REF required.
Three population-matched contrasts frozen before D; each remains exploratory.
Per-site alleles not retained in output; requires another indexed VCF scan.
No independent second outgroup cohort was frozen; avoid post-hoc selection.
Sites excluded for an entirely missing group/outgroup are tallied; partial call rates and invariant callable bases unavailable in SNP-only VCF.
Pooled ABBA/BABA at 5, 50, 100, 250, 500 kb; D computed after pooling.
